verdict.rationale: Formant documents its own export paths: a data-export guide where telemetry is queried programmatically through the Python Cloud SDK and query API, plus device configuration export to YAML. Nothing shows a complete, bulk export of all account data, the file formats of exported telemetry or assets, or an exit or offboarding process. missing for 10: documented bulk export of all data (telemetry, video/assets, events, analytics), explicit open export formats for telemetry, account exit/offboarding guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
